name: solovibe-fullstack
description: Full-stack application with Vite frontend and Python backend

scripts.build: npm install --prefix frontend && echo '=== Dependencies installed ===' && ls -la frontend/dist/ || echo '=== No dist directory yet ===' && npm run build --prefix frontend && echo '=== Build completed ===' && ls -la frontend/dist/ || echo '=== Build failed ==='
scripts.install:all: npm run install:frontend && npm run install:backend
